page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from a low-resolution scan and several vowel points and letters are uncertain; the running head letters are doubtful. Scattered speckle and show-through around the centre of the right column were not transcribed. The blank gap in the right column between the entry "יְהַתְּלוּ" and "וַיּוֹאֶל" contains only marks. The last word "יוּבַל" at the foot of the right column is a catchword, but its exact vowel points are doubtful.
